name: CSI Dataset for Wireless Human Sensing on 80 MHz Wi-Fi Channels
summary: Modern 802.11ac CSI dataset designed for activity recognition, person identification, and people counting with hardware and environment diversity.

hardware.platform: Netgear X4S, Asus RT-AC86U, and TP-Link AD7200 routers; Asus RT-AC86U monitor

settings.scenario: Seven environments, multiple days and router combinations, LOS/NLOS paths, and a semi-anechoic chamber

original.license: CC BY 4.0; a signed-in IEEE DataPort subscription is required to download the archive

standardization.notes: Deinterleave each official [(T × 4), 242] complex CFR matrix into [T, 242, 1, 4]. Preserve all 242 data subcarriers and four monitor streams, then resample only time from the official 173 Hz nominal rate to the 100 Hz, 3 s task view. The schema is verified from the paper; real-byte validation awaits an account-acquired MAT file.
